coverLetter.title: James Valeii
coverLetter.content: I am excited to apply for the Front-end Developer role. I build client-facing websites that balance visual polish, performance, and maintainability. I consult with clients to document requirements, design site appearance and flow, and source and optimize content. I implement interactive features using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and integrate with backend services (MySQL, Git). I also create and prepare assets with Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, run security and quality tests, and tune caching for fast, reliable experiences. I thrive in fast-paced, client-focused consulting environments, meet tight deadlines, and communicate clearly with stakeholders and team members.

summary.name: Abstract
summary.prose: Engineer with 13+ years experience building technical teams and platforms, delivering solutions that drive measurable business impact. Elite PHP and JavaScript developer with deep knowledge of PIM and CMS architecture, extending beyond code to optimal platform configuration, efficient database structuring, and scalable system design. Combines hands-on development and strategic leadership, blending technical expertise with broad knowledge of interacting technologies and an entrepreneurial mindset to design complete systems and make informed build vs. buy decisions based on cost, capability, and long-term maintainability. Sensitive to workflow friction, cutting unnecessary steps to save time, reduce process frustration, and accelerate delivery.
highlights: Ended decade-long content bottleneck; architected modular self-service CMS component library; achieved 100% editorial adoption in 3 months (vs. prior failed attempts). Reclaimed 97% of engineering bandwidth, freeing 2 engineers and 1 PM for strategic work; tripled content output without added headcount.

Drove record e-commerce growth; designed content-gating auth layer that sparked 625% surge in account creations, 84% login growth, and $35 AOV uplift among converted users. Lifted site-wide conversion rate from 2.5% to 4.2% (Labor Day 2024 vs. 2025, per Shopify metrics) and slashed load times from 3s to sub-1s (above gold standard).

Led zero-downtime Shopify migration; single-handedly engineered WordPress–Shopify integration; custom real-time sync plugin preserved inventory/data integrity across 70M+ pageviews with zero revenue loss.

Built cross-functional velocity; embedded with product, science, and editorial teams; bring high curiosity across business domains (formulations, supply chain, and content strategy), informing priority queue, realistic deadlines, and feature design that users love. Turned siloed teams into true collaborators.

work.name: No Borders Inc
work.summary: Holding company scaling/selling e-commerce brands; 5 sites generated $5M+ revenue. Recruited as sole engineer to maintain/optimize full ecosystem of 5 e-commerce sites with 50K+ monthly visitors ($5M revenue); managed priorities, technical decisions, feature development, and maintenance.
highlights: Architected automated merchandising workflow via CSV-WooCommerce integration for 8K+ SKUs, variants, and subscriptions; slashed daily management from 10–25% (1–2 hours) to 5%.
Built custom Google/Shipstation/Twilio SaaS integrations via independent build-vs-buy analysis; saved $45K annually and cut order processing 60%.
Led product, design, and business collaboration to launch 2 conversion-optimized e-commerce sites.

work.name: Boiling Pot Media
work.summary: Full-service digital agency delivering self-service WordPress solutions, hosting, social automation, and e-commerce. Founded solo and scaled agency as lead salesperson, architect, engineer, and client liaison; delivered 125+ international projects while managing sales, hiring/firing, finances, and 24/7 VPS infrastructure for 25+ hosted sites; grew to $250K revenue and strategically exited in most profitable year to refocus on technical leadership.
highlights: Architected unified WordPress for Chegg's ecosystem (EasyBib, BibMe, CiteThisForMe, CitationMachine) serving millions daily; aligned content, graphics, SEO, ad/analytics, and engineering across legacy patchwork.
Built/mentored 3-engineer team; established standards, reviews, and workflows while leading technical contributions; delivered white-label platforms for True Focus Media, SELO Group, and K2 Creative.
Scaled high-traffic sites to 1M+ daily visits with <2s load times via CDN/caching/database optimization.

Expanded offerings to strategic marketing, social automation, print materials, and nonprofit digital-education programs; served as 5-year web department for NLI and 7-year design/web department for KYDNET.
